title: Time-lock agent prompts, plans, memories, TurnQueue, and Commons across timeline rewinds and branches

sections.what: Enforce tick/datetime time-locking in Python prompt builders and Connected-mode Commons, clear server-side agent plan/memory caches on branch switches, and reset browser AgentEngine/PlanTracker/TurnQueue state on rewind or redo.
sections.why: Rewinding the clock or switching branches currently leaves future fallback memories in turn_prompts.py _build_memory_block, stale server-side MemoryManager/PlanManager caches, future Connected-mode Commons messages, and stale browser AgentEngine plans/turn queue slots.
sections.how: Pass max_tick=world.time_ticks into _build_memory_block (engine/agent/prompt_builder/turn_prompts.py) and filter recent_hearing/turn_events by tick <= current_tick in build_room_events_block (engine/agent/prompt_builder/room_context.py). Clear current_app._agent_memory_manager and _agent_plan_manager in routes/timeline_ops.py (switch_branch, redo_decision) and routes/saveload.py (load_world, reset_world). Time-lock Connected-mode Commons message reads when max_datetime is provided from world.datetime_for_tick(). Add AgentEngine.onTimelineSwitch({ branchId, tick, focusCharacter }) in static/js/agent-engine.ts to reset client histories, plans, and TurnQueue slot.
sections.verify: npm run build:ts; pytest tests/test_agent_python_loop.py tests/test_timeline_e2e.py -q

acceptance.text: turn_prompts.py _build_memory_block and room_context.py build_room_events_block filter out any memory or hearing/turn event with tick > world.time_ticks
Switching branches, redoing a decision, or resetting the world clears server-side _agent_memory_manager and _agent_plan_manager caches on current_app
Connected-mode Commons messages in engine/commons.py filter out messages with world_datetime > world.datetime_for_tick() when rewound
AgentEngine.onTimelineSwitch resets browser characterHistories, lastActionResult, PlanTracker plans, and TurnQueue slot/turnNumber (pointing currentTurnIndex to the target character on Redo)

custom.browser_ui: After rewinding or clicking Redo on a character's turn card, the Turn Order strip highlights that character at the rewound tick, Agent Lens shows zero future memories/speech, and Commons hides future messages.
